name: @helm/core
description: Headless Helm logic: discovery, store, launch. Never imports Electron.
//exports: `./types` is the only entry point safe to import for its *values* from the renderer. The package root reaches node:fs through launch/ and store/, and a value import of it from a browser bundle fails at rollup rather than at typecheck. Types themselves are erased, so `import type` from the root is fine anywhere.
